text:
Let’s use a machine learning model to find more earthquakes!

In this challenge , you will use a machine learning (ML) model to do much the same activity as you did yesterday

This ML model has been trained by scientists to recognize all different magnitudes of earthquake signals.

INSTRUCTIONS

1) In the "File" menu in the top left of the right side of CLUE, click "Open". Then, select your document from yesterday, probably called "____". Once that is open, click the "File" menu again and select "Make a Copy". This will make sure your work from yesterday is copied!

2) In your WaveRunner tile from yesterday, we will now run the ML model on the same data. Select "compact model" from the model dropdown list.

3) Click the "Play" button in the bottom toolbar of the model menu.

4) When it is finished running, click the "Timeline It!" button in the bottom control bar of the WaveRunner Tile.
